text: Artificial intelligence is transforming our world, but it also brings serious ethical questions. One major concern is bias: if the data used to train AI systems contains unfair patterns, the AI will repeat them, leading to discrimination in areas like hiring or lending. Fairness means actively checking and correcting these biases, so that decisions are just for everyone. Privacy is another key issue—AI often collects vast amounts of personal information, raising the risk of misuse. Transparency requires that people understand how AI makes decisions, not treating it as a mysterious black box. Above all, responsible AI development means putting human well-being first, testing systems thoroughly, and being open to feedback and regulation.
